records.source: Hey @,^^Just wanted to let you know about a new item I'm carrying... it's called a 'Wood Chipper'.^^You can use it to break hardwood into several pieces of regular wood!^^I know wood can be hard to come by in the winter, so if your supply gets low, consider picking one up.^       -Robin[#]Wood Chipper Notice
records.translation: 嘿，@：^^只是想通知你，我進了一款新商品……名叫「碎木機」。^^可以用它把硬木分解成好幾塊普通木材！^^我知道冬季很難取得木材，所以存量不足時，不妨考慮買一台。^       ——羅賓[#]碎木機通知

records.source: @,^^I've unlocked the back room of the shop.^Come by when you have a chance.^There's something I want to show you.^^-Willy[#]Willy's Back Room Invitation
records.translation: @：^^我已經打開商店後室的門。^有空時過來一趟。^有樣東西想給你看。^^——威利[#]威利的後室邀請

records.source: @, I'm not sure how the human message system works, so I asked Wizard to help me write this letter.^^I hope you are doing okay.^^I wanted to share this with you... it's notes on how my people build a certain item.^^   -Krobus%item craftingRecipe Dark_Sign %%[#]A letter from Krobus
records.translation: @，我不太明白人類的訊息傳遞方式，所以請法師幫忙寫了這封信。^^希望你一切都好。^^我想和你分享這份資料……上面記載著我的族人如何製作某種物品。^^   ——科羅布斯%item craftingRecipe Dark_Sign %%[#]科羅布斯的信

records.source: Dear @,^^Thank you so much for the leeks. They look fresh and delicious. George will love them.^^Today, I'm going to surprise him with 12 little gift-wrapped treasures (thanks to you!). Stop by if you want to be there!^^-Evelyn^^P.S. Please accept this gift. I think you'll enjoy it!%item id (BC)246 %%[#]Evelyn's thank-you note
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^^非常感謝那些韭蔥。看起來新鮮又美味，喬治一定會喜歡。^^今天我要用十二份包裝精美的小寶物給他一個驚喜（多虧了你！）。如果想親眼看看，就過來坐坐吧！^^——伊芙琳^^附言：請收下這份禮物。我想你會喜歡！%item id (BC)246 %%[#]伊芙琳的感謝信

records.source: Hey @,^^Congratulations on completing my little challenge. I'm impressed!^^As an added bonus, I've included the blueprints for a new type of chest. Enjoy!^^-Robin^^^^P.S. -- Now that you have all those resources laying around, why not swing by for some construction work?%item craftingRecipe Stone_Chest %%[#]Robin's Resource Rush
records.translation: 嘿，@：^^恭喜完成我的小挑戰。真令我刮目相看！^^另外附上一份新型石箱的藍圖當作額外獎勵。請笑納！^^——羅賓^^^^附言——現在手邊有那麼多資源，何不順道來找我進行一些建築工程？%item craftingRecipe Stone_Chest %%[#]羅賓的資源熱潮

records.source: Um, Hello...     ^Thanks for helping me clear out those monsters.^^I'm not scared at all! ...But it should make the mines safer for everyone else... right?^^Take this blueprint. (Hope it doesn't make me obsolete...)^^   -Clint, the blacksmith%item craftingRecipe Geode_Crusher %%[#]Clint's Thank-you
records.translation: 呃，你好……     ^謝謝你幫忙清除那些怪物。^^我一點也不害怕！……不過這樣應該能讓其他人在礦井裡更安全……對吧？^^收下這份藍圖。（希望它不會讓我被淘汰……）^^   ——鐵匠克林特%item craftingRecipe Geode_Crusher %%[#]克林特的謝禮

records.source: Um, Hello...     ^Thanks for helping me clear out more monsters.^^Maybe next time, I'll take care of them myself... if I have time!^^Take this item. I found it in the back room...^^   -Clint, the blacksmith%item id (O)286 10 (O)287 5 (O)231 3 %%[#]Clint's Alternate Thank-you
records.translation: 呃，你好……     ^謝謝你幫忙清除更多怪物。^^也許下次我會親自解決牠們……如果有空的話！^^收下這些東西。是我在後室找到的……^^   ——鐵匠克林特%item id (O)286 10 (O)287 5 (O)231 3 %%[#]克林特的另一份謝禮

records.source: ^^   -Willy%item craftingRecipe Quality_Bobber %%[#]Willy's Thank-you
records.translation: ^^   ——威利%item craftingRecipe Quality_Bobber %%[#]威利的謝禮

records.source: Dear @,^^I guess people didn't take to 'Pierre's Prime Produce' like I'd hoped...^^Anyways, here's my old 'Mini-Shipping Bin'.^The next time you get your hands on some produce worthy of the 'Pierre's Prime' luxury brand, maybe you could have them shipped my way?^^   -Pierre%item id (BC)248 %%[#]Pierre's Prime Produce
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^^看來大家不像我期望的那樣喜愛「皮埃爾特選農產品」……^^總之，這個舊「迷你出貨箱」送給你。^下次拿到配得上「皮埃爾特選」奢華品牌的農產品時，也許能用它出貨給我？^^   ——皮埃爾%item id (BC)248 %%[#]皮埃爾特選農產品

records.source: @,^I wanted to thank you for taking care of my special order. All of the hard work you've done has been a great boost to Pelican Town's image.^Here's a 'Mini-Shipping Bin' as a token of my appreciation.^Place it anywhere and I'll be sure to make a stop when I make my rounds.^^   -Lewis%item id (BC)248 %%[#]Lewis's Thank You
records.translation: @：^謝謝你完成我的特別訂單。你付出的所有努力，大幅提升了鵜鶘鎮的形象。^這個「迷你出貨箱」代表我的謝意。^可以放在任何地方，我巡視時一定會順道停留。^^   ——路易斯%item id (BC)248 %%[#]路易斯的謝禮

records.source: The specimen you delivered offered great insight into the machinations of the fell beings we call 'monsters'.^^I've formulated a pungent tincture that these beings find intoxicating. Use it with caution...^^   -M. Rasmodius, Wizard%item craftingRecipe Monster_Musk %%[#]The Wizard's Discovery
records.translation: 你送來的標本，讓我深入了解了那些被稱為「怪物」的邪惡生物如何運作。^^我調製出一種氣味強烈的酊劑，能讓這些生物如癡如醉。使用時務必小心……^^   ——法師 M・拉斯莫迪斯%item craftingRecipe Monster_Musk %%[#]法師的發現

records.source: Thanks to the ectoplasm you delivered to me, I've made a major breakthrough in the field of arcane engineering.^^Enclosed, you'll find blueprints for a most useful machine...^^   -M. Rasmodius, Wizard%item craftingRecipe Mini-Obelisk %%[#]The Wizard's Breakthrough
records.translation: 多虧你送來的靈質，我在奧術工程領域取得了重大突破。^^隨信附上一種極其實用的裝置藍圖……^^   ——法師 M・拉斯莫迪斯%item craftingRecipe Mini-Obelisk %%[#]法師的突破

records.source: Hi @,^^Thanks for your help with the fish.^Nature is usually good at keeping things balanced, but sometimes artificial factors can cause an imbalance.^^I've enclosed a blueprint from a science magazine that you might find interesting.^^-Demetrius%item craftingRecipe Farm_Computer %%[#]Demetrius' Thank You
records.translation: 嗨，@：^^謝謝你協助處理那些魚。^自然通常很擅長維持平衡，但人為因素有時也會造成失衡。^^隨信附上一份科學雜誌刊載的藍圖，你也許會覺得很有意思。^^——德米特里厄斯%item craftingRecipe Farm_Computer %%[#]德米特里厄斯的謝禮

records.source: Good news!^^The ol' boat is seaworthy once again, thanks to you!^^Stop by the back room whenever you want a ride.^^My shop is now open at 8AM every day, so you can get an early start.^^-Willy[#]Willy's Boat
records.translation: 好消息！^^多虧了你，那艘老船又能出海了！^^任何時候想搭船，都可以到後室來找我。^^我的商店現在每天上午八點開門，讓你可以提早出發。^^——威利[#]威利的船

records.source: Hi @,^^Thanks for helping me clean up around the valley.^The waters are looking much cleaner. I think everyone will appreciate it. I know I will.^As a way of saying 'thanks', I wanted to teach you how to grow your own fiber. I hope it's useful.^^-Linus%item craftingRecipe Fiber_Seeds %%[#]Linus' Thank You
records.translation: 嗨，@：^^謝謝你幫忙清理山谷各處的垃圾。^水域看起來乾淨多了。我想大家都會心懷感激，至少我一定會。^為了表達謝意，我想教你如何自行種植纖維。希望能派上用場。^^——萊納斯%item craftingRecipe Fiber_Seeds %%[#]萊納斯的謝禮

records.source: Hi @,^^Thanks for the eggs.^The yolks look amazing... I think this will be my best omelet yet!^^Please accept this gift.^^-Gus%item id (BC)216 %%[#]Gus' Famous Omelet
records.translation: 嗨，@：^^謝謝你送來這些蛋。^蛋黃看起來棒極了……我想這會是自己至今做過最出色的歐姆蛋！^^請收下這份禮物。^^——格斯%item id (BC)216 %%[#]格斯的知名歐姆蛋

records.source: Hey kid,^^Thanks for the 'juice'. It definitely had a ...one-of-a-kind... flavor.^^By the way, have you ever tuned in to channel 736? It's a seasonal fishing program that you might find interesting.^^Take care,^-Pam[#]Pam's Tip
records.translation: 嘿，孩子：^^謝謝你的「果汁」。那股味道絕對……獨一無二……^^順帶一提，有沒有看過第 736 頻道？那是季節限定的釣魚節目，你也許會覺得很有意思。^^保重，^——潘姆[#]潘姆的提示

records.source: Hi @,^^Thanks again for the wonderful gemstones.^These will be perfect for my energy re-alignment work!^I wanted to thank you with this special gift. I hope you create some wonderful items with it!^^-Emily%item id (BC)247 %%[#]Emily's Gemstones
records.translation: 嗨，@：^^再次感謝你送來那些美麗寶石。^它們非常適合用在我的能量重新校準工作！^我想用這份特別的禮物向你道謝。希望你能用它創造出一些奇妙物品！^^——艾蜜莉%item id (BC)247 %%[#]艾蜜莉的寶石

records.source: Hi @,^^Lewis told me that you've been shipping a lot of ingredients from the island! It's great to have access to new produce... it really opens a whole new world of culinary possibilities!^I'm including a gift for you... some blueprints you might find useful.^^-Caroline%item craftingRecipe Solar_Panel %%[#]Caroline's Tropical Ingredients
records.translation: 嗨，@：^^路易斯告訴我，你一直從島上出貨大量食材！能取得全新的農產品真是太好了……真的開啟了一整個嶄新的料理可能性世界！^隨信附上一份禮物……是幾張你也許用得上的藍圖。^^——卡洛琳%item craftingRecipe Solar_Panel %%[#]卡洛琳的熱帶食材

records.source: @,^^Congrats on a successful island fishing trip. I'm proud of ya!^^Here, take this special fish tank. It'll make a great piece in your house.^^-Willy%item id (F)2312 %%[#]Willy's Tropical Challenge
records.translation: @：^^恭喜成功完成島嶼釣魚之旅。我為你感到驕傲！^^喏，收下這座特別的魚缸。擺在家裡一定會很好看。^^——威利%item id (F)2312 %%[#]威利的熱帶挑戰

records.source: @,^^You never showed up at the boat, so I went lookin' for ya.^^Found you sprawled out in the dirt, with a couple o' parrots pulling gold out of your pockets!^^Had to drag you all the way down to the boat. Me legs feel like two freshwater shrimp...^-Willy
records.translation: @：^^你一直沒有來搭船，所以我就去找你了。^^結果發現你四肢攤開倒在泥地裡，還有幾隻鸚鵡正從口袋裡掏走金幣！^^我只好一路把你拖到船上。兩條腿感覺就像軟腳蝦……^——威利

records.source: Hi @,^^Last night, I found you slumbering in the dark.^It wasn't a very safe place, so the bird friends air-lifted you to your bed.^Please be careful from now on.^^-Leo^^P.S. Willy helped me write this.
records.translation: 嗨，@：^^昨晚，我發現你在黑暗中沉睡。^那裡不太安全，所以鳥兒朋友們把你空運回床上。^今後請務必小心。^^——雷歐^^附言：威利幫我寫了這封信。

records.source: Hi @,^^Thanks for all the bones. I've got a lot to sort through here! To think, each fragment belonged to a living, breathing body from the past. Fascinating.^^Please accept this unique crafting recipe as a thank-you gift!^^-Gunther%item craftingRecipe Bone_Mill %%[#]Gunther's Note
records.translation: 嗨，@：^^謝謝你送來所有骨頭。這裡可有一大堆東西要整理！想到每一塊碎片都曾屬於過去一具活生生的軀體，實在令人著迷。^^請收下這份獨特的製作配方，作為謝禮！^^——岡瑟%item craftingRecipe Bone_Mill %%[#]岡瑟的便條

records.source: @,^Here's a food from my home, that me and my family enjoy. Hope you like it. ^^  -Leo^^P.S. Willy helped me write this.%item cookingRecipe %%[#]Leo's Recipe
records.translation: @：^這是來自我家鄉的食物，我和家人都很喜歡。希望你也會喜歡。^^  ——雷歐^^附言：威利幫我寫了這封信。%item cookingRecipe %%[#]雷歐的食譜

records.source: Hello.^^I've heard you're working on a very special challenge.^^I have the 'perfect' solution to help you out.^^Meet me in the watery cave on Ginger Island.^^-Fizz^Joja Special Services Division[#]Letter From Fizz
records.translation: 你好。^^聽說你正在完成一項非常特別的挑戰。^^我有個「完美」方案能幫上忙。^^到薑島的水簾洞來見我。^^——菲茲^Joja 特別服務部[#]菲茲的信

records.source: Saw the weather report last night.^^I'm not sure what will happen, but if anyone wants to take shelter in the Saloon, I'll keep it open all day.^^-Gus[#]Shelter In The Saloon
records.translation: 昨晚看了天氣預報。^^我不確定會發生什麼事，不過如果有人想來酒館避難，我會讓這裡全天開放。^^——格斯[#]在酒館避難

records.source: Dear @,^^Tomorrow begins a 3-day festival in Calico Desert.^^With the bus back in order, we're all delighted to be able to continue this time-honored, beloved tradition.^^There will be games, free food, prizes, and much more!^^Also, two townspeople are selected each day to run a little shop, so make sure you swing by and check out what they have to offer.^^See you there!^-Lewis[#]Desert Festival Reminder
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^^為期三天的沙漠節將在明天於卡利科沙漠揭幕。^^公車恢復正常運行，讓大家都很高興能延續這項歷史悠久且深受喜愛的傳統。^^現場會有遊戲、免費食物、獎品，還有更多精彩內容！^^另外，每天會選出兩位鎮民經營小商店，因此一定要順道看看他們準備了哪些商品。^^到時見！^——路易斯[#]沙漠節提醒

records.source: Dear @,^^From what I can tell, you've been taking really good care of your pet! I'm really happy about that!^^But there are many sweet animals that need a home... If you're interested, I'll start offering pet adoptions at my shop.^^Just be aware that there is a licensing fee, and also that each pet will want their own outdoor pet bowl area, or else they'll be unhappy. Robin will be happy to construct additional pet bowls, for a price.^^See you soon!^-Marnie[#]Pet Adoptions Letter
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^^據我觀察，你一直把寵物照顧得非常好！這真的讓我很開心！^^不過，還有許多可愛的動物需要一個家……如果有興趣，我會開始在商店提供寵物領養服務。^^只是要注意，領養必須支付執照費，而且每隻寵物都會需要自己在戶外的寵物碗區域，否則牠們會不開心。只要付費，羅賓很樂意建造額外的寵物碗。^^待會兒見！^——瑪妮[#]寵物領養信

records.source: Dear @,^^I hope this letter finds you well.^^I know you decided against adopting a pet when I last asked. However, if you've changed your mind, I am now offering pet adoptions from my shop.^^See you around!^-Marnie[#]Pet Adoptions Letter
records.translation: 親愛的 @：^^希望收到這封信時一切安好。^^我知道上次詢問時，你決定不領養寵物。不過，如果現在改變了心意，我已經開始在商店提供寵物領養服務。^^有空見！^——瑪妮[#]寵物領養信
